Instructions

How to play

Move and jumpWASD to walk, mouse to look, Shift to run and Space to jump. You jump farther when running.
The trialsBefore each thinker there is a proof of his philosophy: the river of Thales, the fire of Heraclitus, the harmonic staircase of Pythagoras... If you fall, you go back to the last mainland with a little less reason.
TalkWalk up to a philosopher and press E (or “Speak”): ask him who he is, what his great idea is, listen to his lesson, or ask him your own questions.
DashC o Ctrl: a quick jump in the direction you move. For a moment you are invulnerable: use it to dodge assaults and projectiles.
DiscoverThe golden rhombus marks places: the Parthenon, the Agora, the Library of Alexandria... Everyone tells you their story and gives you a fragment of wisdom.
DebatesChallenge a philosopher from the conversation. Answer with click or with 1–4. Acertar quiebra su convicción; fallar daña tu razón.
Dialogues and notebookFifteen thinkers, such as Socrates, Heraclitus, Confucius, Buddha, Descartes, Kant, Beauvoir, Camus or Freire, propose an idea: take a stand, give your best reason and respond to their objection. There is no one-size-fits-all answer: tell the quality of your reasons. And in the Notebook you can write your answer to each thinker's question, and see your philosophical map: where you find yourself in six big questions and with which thinkers you agree.
Thought experimentsLook for the doors that shine next to some thinkers: Plato's cave, the ring of Gyges and the boat of Theseus in Athens, the room of Descartes, the rock of Sisyphus, the river of Heraclitus, the dream of the butterfly of Zhuangzi and the ladder of Wittgenstein. Inside, approach what shines and presses E (or tap the screen) to decide what you would do.
LifelinesThe fragments you gain by discovering places serve in the debates: Maieutics elimina dos respuestas falsas; Water clock adds ten seconds.
The pathEvery age is a straight path: thinkers await you one after the other, in order. By beating each one, the door of light opens to the next. The golden marker and the bar above guide you; touch it (or tap E) to walk to it automatically.
On your phonePut your thumb in the left half to move, slide right to look or tap the ground to walk to that point. The big button serves to talk and discover.
StreaksEvery three straight moves up the wisdom multiplier: ×2, ×3 and up to ×4. A failure restarts it.
